behaviour: qrco.de is the short-link domain of QR Code Generator PRO. Its help center says that after the trial, dynamic codes are deactivated and point to a service page.
l.ead.me is a short-link domain named on the help pages of QR Code Generator PRO. Its help center says that after the trial, dynamic codes are deactivated and point to a service page.
qr1.be is the default short-link domain of QR TIGER. QR TIGER's page says its free dynamic codes are capped and require a subscription to stay active.
sqr.co is a short-link domain used by SQR. Users on AppSumo reported that their codes stopped working after the vendor appeared to shut down.

scango.to is a default redirect domain of Hovercode. Its help center says that if a paid plan is cancelled, the account moves to the free plan: the first 3 dynamic codes keep working, and any beyond that become inactive until you subscribe again.
qrcodes.pro is a domain Uniqode's help center lists for its QR codes. Its help center says dynamic codes stop working when a trial expires, or after the renewal date once a plan is cancelled.
